Pharmacopoeias. In Jpn. Profile Oxazolam is a long-acting benzodiazepine with general proper- ties similar to those of diazepam (p.986). It has been given by mouth for the short-term treatment of anxiety disorders. Oxazolam has also been used as a premedicant in general anaes- thesia.
